name: Azure Network Security Assessment
description: Security assessment of Azure networking configurations. Covers virtual networks, network security groups (NSGs), Azure Firewall, Application Gateway, Private Link, VNet peering, ExpressRoute, and network segmentation within Azure environments.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to Azure network security assessment

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands Azure VNet architecture and network security primitives
evidence: Can explain VNets, subnets, NSGs, and Azure Firewall
Understands the difference between NSGs and Azure Firewall
Familiar with Azure network topology options (peering, hub-spoke)

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Reviews Azure network configurations under supervision using established tooling
evidence: Enumerates VNet configurations and NSG rules with guidance
Identifies overly permissive NSG rules using lab checklists
Documents network security findings with supervision

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently assesses Azure network architecture and segmentation
evidence: Independently reviews network segmentation across multi-VNet environments
Identifies lateral movement risks through VNet peering and service endpoint misconfigurations
Evaluates VNet flow logs (successor to retiring NSG flow logs) and Azure Network Watcher data for security insights

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Handles complex multi-region Azure network assessments; develops automated analysis tooling
evidence: Assesses complex hub-and-spoke and Azure Virtual WAN architectures
Develops tooling for automated NSG and network path analysis
Reviews network assessment work of junior analysts
Evaluates hybrid connectivity (ExpressRoute, VPN Gateway) security

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Defines lab Azure network assessment methodology; publishes network security research
evidence: Designed or maintains the lab's Azure network security assessment framework
Published research on Azure network security bypass or segmentation failures
Trains teams on advanced Azure network security assessment
Recognized as authority on Azure network architecture security

assessment_methods.description: Assess a multi-VNet Azure environment and identify all network segmentation weaknesses and lateral movement paths
Review network security findings from recent Azure assessments

cis: CIS Microsoft Azure Foundations Benchmark v5.0.0 - Section 7 Networking Services
